description: Redux keeps shared app state in one store. Actions describe changes, and reducers decide the next state. This course uses Redux Toolkit to make those rules short and clear, with tiny counters and reading lists. Use a JavaScript project with @reduxjs/toolkit installed. React examples also need react-redux and React. These imports require your project build tool and are not available in the plain playground.
versionNote: Uses Redux Toolkit 2 and React Redux hooks.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change the slice name and inspect the action type
Learn to compare the before and after objects
Learn to find which part of the tree receives the store
learningObjectives: Learn to change the slice name and inspect the action type
